last.summary: Resolved the merge conflict in projects/bzip2/oracle/Bzip2/Oracle.lean by taking origin/master's version (the file is not owned by this task; it already imports Error/Decompress/Compress, and Crc is built by Lake as its own module). Committed the merge. Verify then failed style because the previous commit had put the CRC tests into tests/Bzip2/Tests.lean (outside the task's allowed files, and a 132-char line). I reverted Tests.lean to origin/master and moved the tests into tests/Bzip2/Test/Crc.lean as #guards (check value, empty, slices and clamping, table entries 0-3, 128, 252-255 read from upstream/crctable.c lines 35/67/98, combine per compress.c:607-608). Checked: `sh -c 'projects/bzip2/tools/verify.sh && projects/bzip2/tools/check-task.sh oracle/crc'` exits 0: 'verify: packages/sources/build/style/axioms/lint/test: ok', 'verify: ok', 'check-task: oracle/crc: ok'. git status is clean; git diff --stat origin/master...HEAD lists only oracle/Bzip2/Oracle/Crc.lean and tests/Bzip2/Test/Crc.lean.
